jobs.prompt: A 1536x1024 sprite sheet laid out as a strict 2-column by 4-row grid of eight equal cells, read left to right then top to bottom, showing one attack effect across eight animation frames: 1 anticipation, 2 release, 3 travel, 4 travel, 5 pre-contact, 6 contact peak, 7 reaction, 8 dissipation. Hand-painted storybook game VFX with dark confident outlines and restrained afterglow, matching the rendering, line weight and cell framing of the reference sheet exactly. The effect body only: no characters, no creatures, no scenery, no floor, no UI, no text, no numbers, no frame borders. Every cell sits on the same flat uniform cyan chroma background for keying. Critical: the effect itself must contain no cyan, aqua, turquoise or pale sky-blue anywhere, so that it stays clearly separable from the cyan background when the background is keyed out. The effect is a blooming cloud of stardust that flashes bright enough to blind, spreading across the whole width. Frame 1 fine glitter draws inward into a dense compact seed. Frames 2-4 it blooms outward as a wide soft cloud of drifting motes with long lens-flare needles. Frame 6 the cloud flashes at its brightest with a broad cream-white veil and radiating spikes. Frames 7-8 the veil dims and the motes scatter and drift down. Palette: deep violet and plum, warm golden starlight, cream-white core.
